protected_records: All customer-origin cases and any case without complete rehearsal-resolution evidence must remain unchanged.
required_checks: Inspect the live support_cases schema and row count.
Query every open case with its origin, type, site, serial, narrative, priority, resolution code, and resolution evidence.
Compare protected and candidate records with the immutable baseline.
Execute one narrowly scoped UPDATE and inspect the JSON success field and rowcount.
Query all affected and protected rows after the write.
Run PRAGMA integrity_check and PRAGMA foreign_key_check on the live database.
